description: Presidential Secretariat - Amend the Duties & Functions Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2103/33 & 2103/34 (Reference heading Ministry of Defence : Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation)
categorisation: This gazette notification names a specific individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and outlines detailed portfolio responsibilities and subject matter assignments for government ministries, specifically adding new functions to the Minister of Defence portfolio and making changes to the Non-Cabinet Minister of Mass Media portfolio. The content contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
